title_zh: 发现舞台帽装饰脱落并约定修补

scenario.label_zh: 发现舞台帽装饰脱落并约定修补
scenario.goal_zh: 确认羽毛来自舞台帽，改戴备用帽并约定把损坏帽交给服装负责人修补

context_zh: 演员准备排练时发现舞台帽的装饰脱落。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Rosie
sentences.text: Is this feather from your stage hat? I found it beside the costume box.

sentences.speaker: Malik
sentences.text: Yes. The hat looks rather bare without it. Could you give it to the costume manager?

sentences.speaker: Rosie
sentences.text: Of course. What will you wear for this rehearsal?

sentences.speaker: Malik
sentences.text: The plain spare hat. I will leave this one with the feather for her to repair.
